ect and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List

ady there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The ac

r's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"accou
nt_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, sa
me id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account h
as creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account
.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (bes
t effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the
default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_n
ame_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `P
UT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creatin
g an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecatio
n: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project i
n the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `ma
xProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a project and everything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/projects/delete-a-project-and-everything-scoped-to-it.md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the
mapped workspace and its memberships, every saved server in the project (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the
host configs that referenced it), and hosted tasks. Requires project admin. The request body must be…\n- [Update project metadata
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requi
res project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirms that a project exists. The project's
server map is not updatable here. See the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of derived booleans, so an agent on a static s
urface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write and reading the failure.\n- [Save a server into a project](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its deta
il. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names a
re unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the existing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server
's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newes
t first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or
a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot
…\n- [Get one server revision](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-server-revision.md): One stored revision: eve
ry tool's definition and the server info the server reported. `droppedFields` lists paths storage dropped for size; their values a
re unknown, not absent.\n- [Diff two server revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md)
: Compares `from` (default: the revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools chan
ged with the fields that moved and both definitions, and each changed server info field with both values. Revision 1 has nothing b
efore it, so diffing it needs `from`. A fi…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-
server.md): The server's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included: `hasClientSecret` reports presence
only. A server id from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/d
